name: to-google-rich-json-ld
description: Transform any JSON-LD document into a Google Rich Results compatible JSON-LD document

scripts.build: tsc && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('./dist/generated', { recursive: true }); fs.readdirSync('./src/generated').filter(f => f.endsWith('.json')).forEach(f => fs.copyFileSync('./src/generated/' + f, './dist/generated/' + f));"
